mode.description: Whether the user input represents ideas/facts (mode_a) or direct canvas modification instructions (mode_b).

template.description: Optional diagram template requested in Mode B (e.g., 'ishikawa_6m', 'mindmap', 'flowchart', 'venn', null).

clusters.description: Semantic groupings or themes derived from topical similarity. Does NOT imply a formal edge.

concepts.description: Explicit concepts, facts, or entities mentioned in the speech.

type.description: Specific semantic role: process_step (operational action), side_annotation (note/caveat/observation), data_store (spreadsheet/DB/repository), decision_gate (condition/approval), actor (role/system), or concept.

source_ids.description: Transcript segment IDs justifying this concept. Scaffolding may have empty array.

relationships.description: Explicit relationships between concepts. Must NEVER be created purely from similarity.

relation_type.description: Semantic type of the relation (e.g., depends_on, requires, causes, leads_to, part_of, triggers, creates, references, belongs_to_branch).

source_ids.description: Transcript segment IDs explicitly stating this relationship. REQUIRED.

direct_actions.description: Direct layout or manipulation instructions when in Mode B.

action.description: Action type (e.g., move, group, align, layout_reorganize, reorganize, create_template, delete, restyle, rename).

target_ids.description: Target node/cluster IDs or ['canvas'] for global actions.
